summary: Turn self-assessment into workplace goals, feedback actions, and a personal development plan. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Personal development training helps professionals turn workplace feedback and capability gaps into focused development actions. For professionals, team leaders, and supervisors, it covers reviewing strengths and development needs, setting SMART goals, and creating practical development plans. Learners practise structured reflection, feedback conversations, and progress reviews to sustain improvement alongside everyday responsibilities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who want a structured way to develop workplace capabilities, use feedback, and sustain purposeful improvement without making task-management systems the centre of their development work.
prerequisites: No specialist qualification is required. Familiarity with your current role and work routines will help you apply the reflection and planning exercises.
